title: PROPOSAL (Tier-2): live per-bar position_telemetry history, so the in-trade exit model can be parity-checked and later served
owner: lane (Opus); human merge per operator approval 2026-10-15
note: [2026-10-14 lane IN-TRADE-EXIT-MODEL] PROPOSAL ONLY -- not built, not approved. src/runtime/position_telemetry.py keeps ONE upserted row per position (peak_r, giveback_r, bars_since_peak; latest only), so a live trade's path is overwritten bar by bar and MAE is never stored. The in-trade exit model (row IN-TRADE-EXIT-MODEL) is learned OFFLINE from harness path emits (row EXIT-PATH-EMIT-OFFLINE, the priority); this row is what lets it be (1) PARITY-checked on live trades (harness state at bar t == live state at bar t, the exit-refinement skill's parity step) and (2) eventually SERVED in shadow. PROPOSED SHAPE: an append-only per-bar history alongside the upsert (same writer, same tick, one row per open position per bar close: ts, order_package_id, open_r, peak_r, mae_r, bars_since_peak, sl/tp in force in R, atr, adx), a declared canonical-source relationship for the new-table-wiring guard (it PROJECTS the same telemetry, never a second truth), a retention bound, and a /api/diag read path. TIER-2 (runtime writer + DB table): prepare + validate, one operator OK, ship, verify post-state per CLAUDE.md. CONSUMERS: blocked/RQ-20261014-9807-05 (live rows as its parity read, never pooled), the shadow rung of the exit ladder (Programme 01 Q8). Not a prerequisite for any research unit filed 2026-10-14; schedule it when the offline model has a PASS worth shadowing.
